note: RV park and campground on 27 heavily shaded, wooded acres just north of Keokuk, 1/2 mile off Hwy 61/218. Gravel pads, tent sites with 20-amp, stocked fishing pond, lighted pavilion, hiking trails. --Claude
summary: New rates $45-50 one night ($40-45 for 2+). Confirmed 53 sites, 50 amp full hookups, year-round, RoverPass (claimed and bookable). Max 75->95. Not waterfront stands; pond small.
flags: GATE FACTS: one night $45 on 30 amp (RoverPass, read for January and June 2027), under $50; $50 on 50 amp, and $40 a night for 2+ nights. GS: not a Good Sam Park (stored false stands). Gateway: none within 40 km (St. Louis 229 km). Presence: working site, phone (319) 795-4822, claimed RoverPass engine. RATINGS: Google 4.6 (242 reviews); RV Life 4.5 stars, tier 2. Passes.

LONG-STAY: not a concern on what I read. Engine has separate '1- Day' and 'Long-Term' rate classes, 'The maximum rental period is 30 days, renewable'. RV Life reviews of 2025-26 are mostly stopovers at $43-60 a night; one monthly: 'I have been here for 6 months', 'Good spot for families and traveling workers alike' (5/2025). Note: reviews quote $60 and $50 in 2025, above the engine's current figures.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. Two small ponds on imagery near the pin, the larger about 60 x 45 m, well under 5 acres: a pond, no value. The pads lie in woods on the far side of a drive from it. Pin fine (at the south end of the loops, about 100 m from the middle). Stored note's 'accommodates up to 75 ft' is replaced by the engine's 95 ft; a large fig but the engine's own.
